description: Records that the person turned down what an edit plan suggested for its opening (kind visual_pick: the look to open on; hook_pick: the first line) and why: not_for_me, wrong (it does not fit what the video shows) or on_purpose (the person meant to do it differently). A look turned down is left out of this workspace's plans for 30 days. job_id: an edit job from edit_jobs_list.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

job_id.description: The edit job whose plan made the suggestion

kind.description: visual_pick: the look to open on; hook_pick: the first line

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: suggestion_respond
title: Turn down a suggestion
